mcp.name: add_vessel
mcp.description: Register a new vessel (git repository) in a fleet

mcp.name: annotate_blackbox
mcp.description: Add a note to a black box entry (body 1-8000 characters; recorded with authorKind Agent, or AskArmada from an Ask Armada conversation). Annotate what you found and what you did, so the next reader does not repeat it. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: apply_backlog_refinement_summary
mcp.description: Apply a refinement summary back to the linked backlog item and optionally promote its backlog state. Ends the session and releases its captain unless endSession is false.

mcp.name: apply_blackbox_recommendation
mcp.description: Apply one configuration recommendation recorded in a black box entry's analysis (recommendationId) to prevent the failure next time; it runs only the recorded applyAction (for example an update_vessel patch), authorized as that tool. Same flow as run_blackbox_recovery: dry run first (dryRun defaults to true) to get the action and a confirmToken, tell the user what will change, then apply with dryRun false and the token. Read the black box summary first. Quote evidence, not guesses. State the triage verdict and whether you agree. If you act, use only recovery paths or recommendations from the entry, do a dry run, tell the user what will happen, and confirm before running anything marked dataLossRisk. Annotate the entry with what you did. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: apply_fleet_recommendations
mcp.description: Apply fleet recommendations to an import batch: reuses tenant fleets with the same name (case-insensitive) or creates them, and assigns each listed vessel. Pass fleets to apply an edited list, or omit it to apply the captain's stored recommendations unchanged. A fleet named Uncategorized is not created. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: approve_ask_proposal
mcp.description: Approve an action Armada proposed in an Ask Armada conversation, so it runs now.

mcp.name: approve_deployment
mcp.description: Approve a pending deployment and begin execution.

mcp.name: approve_mission_review
mcp.description: Approve a mission waiting at a pipeline review gate (status Review). A non-final stage continues to the next stage with this stage's branch, diff, and output; a final stage continues to landing. Set conditional with a comment to pass guidance to the following stages. Refused for captain sessions.

mcp.name: backup
mcp.description: Create a ZIP backup of the Armada database and settings for disaster recovery. Uses SQLite online backup API for a consistent snapshot.

mcp.name: cancel_ask_turn
mcp.description: Stop the turn running in an Ask Armada conversation.

mcp.name: cancel_fleet_action_run
mcp.description: Cancel a fleet action run: pending targets are cancelled, running commands are killed, and unlanded voyages of a Mission run are cancelled.

mcp.name: cancel_merge
mcp.description: Cancel a queued merge entry

mcp.name: cancel_mission
mcp.description: Cancel a specific mission

mcp.name: cancel_voyage
mcp.description: Cancel an entire voyage and its Pending, Assigned, and Blocked missions. Returns the voyage with CancelledMissions and NotCancelledMissions counts; read which missions remain with enumerate (entityType missions, voyageId).

mcp.name: categorize_vessel_import
mcp.description: Run or retry fleet categorization for an import batch whose import finished: a captain reads a manifest of the batch's selected repositories and recommends fleets (FleetCategorization background job). Omitted arguments reuse the batch's previous captain, prompt, and auto-apply choice. Poll the batch (enumerate entityType vessel_import_batch, or the job) until categorizationStatus is Completed, Failed, or Applied. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: classify_stage_outcome
mcp.description: Classify a stage outcome's suspected cause by hand (causeSource Manual, recorded with the caller as classifier); the rules never overwrite a manual cause. Omit cause to clear the manual cause and hand the outcome back to the rules.

mcp.name: cli_permission_prompt
mcp.description: Permission prompt tool for CLI captains (Claude Code --permission-prompt-tool). Only callable by a captain's own mission- or Ask-thread-scoped session; people decide requests with decide_cli_permission_request. Waits until an approver allows or denies the call, a CLI permission rule decides it, or it expires, then returns {"behavior":"allow","updatedInput":{...}} or {"behavior":"deny","message":"..."}.

mcp.name: create_ask_thread
mcp.description: Start a new Ask Armada conversation. Optionally give it a title, choose the captain that answers, and set whether its proposed actions run without asking (autoApprove).

mcp.name: create_backlog_item
mcp.description: Create a backlog item that can link vessels, planning sessions, voyages, checks, releases, deployments, and incidents.

mcp.name: create_backlog_planning_session
mcp.description: Create a repository-aware planning session from a backlog item while preserving the objective linkage.

mcp.name: create_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Start a captain-backed refinement session for a backlog item. The caller must specify the captain explicitly.

mcp.name: create_captain
mcp.description: Register a new captain (AI agent)

mcp.name: create_cli_permission_rule
mcp.description: Create a CLI permission rule (admins). A matching deny rule denies a captain's permission prompt without asking; a matching allow rule allows it. Scope Global applies to every captain of the tenant (a global admin may omit tenantId to apply it to every tenant), Vessel to missions on one vessel, Captain to one captain.

mcp.name: create_deployment
mcp.description: Create a bounded deployment record and execute it immediately when approval is not required.

mcp.name: create_failure_cause_rule
mcp.description: Create a failure-cause rule. A global admin may set tenantId (omit for every tenant); anyone else creates a rule for their own tenant. Every match criterion given must match (AND); within a list any value matches (OR). Invalid when the name is missing or over 200 characters, the match has no criterion, the cause is None, or textPattern is not a valid regular expression.

mcp.name: create_fleet
mcp.description: Create a new fleet (collection of repositories)

mcp.name: create_fleet_action
mcp.description: Create a reusable fleet action. Kind Command runs commandText in each vessel's working directory (tenant admin only); kind Mission dispatches one voyage per vessel from promptTemplate. Templates may use {{vessel.name}}, {{vessel.id}}, {{vessel.defaultBranch}}, {{vessel.workingDirectory}}, {{vessel.buildCommand}}, {{health.summary}}.

mcp.name: create_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Pre-register a Harbor. A Harbor also self-registers on first handshake; use this to reserve a name/capacity before it connects.

mcp.name: create_memory
mcp.description: Create a durable memory, or update it in place when a memory with the same key already exists (idempotent consolidation). Classify the content as Episodic (what happened/when), Semantic (a standalone fact), or Procedural (how to do something). Working memory is never stored.

mcp.name: create_mission
mcp.description: Create and dispatch a standalone mission to a vessel

mcp.name: create_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Create a managed model endpoint. Kind must be one of Embedding, Inference; Provider is one of Ollama, OpenAI, OpenAICompatible, Anthropic, Gemini, VoyageAI, AzureOpenAI, VertexAI, Bedrock, OllamaCloud, XAI. Anthropic cannot be used for Embedding and VoyageAI cannot be used for Inference.

mcp.name: create_objective
mcp.description: Create an internal-first objective or intake-style record that can link vessels, planning sessions, voyages, checks, releases, deployments, and incidents.

mcp.name: create_persona
mcp.description: Create a new persona with a name and prompt template reference

mcp.name: create_pipeline
mcp.description: Create a new pipeline with an ordered sequence of persona stages

mcp.name: create_playbook
mcp.description: Create a new markdown playbook.

mcp.name: create_prompt_template
mcp.description: Create a new prompt template.

mcp.name: create_release
mcp.description: Create a first-class release record from linked voyages, missions, and structured checks, with derived version, notes, and artifacts when available.

mcp.name: create_workflow_profile
mcp.description: Create a workflow profile. At least one command is required. Scope Fleet needs fleetId and scope Vessel needs vesselId. Setting isDefault clears the default flag on the other profiles at the same scope. Tenant admins only, as over REST.

mcp.name: decide_cli_permission_request
mcp.description: Allow once, allow and remember (store an allow rule; admins only), allow for the conversation (set the Ask thread to Bypass; the admin thread owner only), or deny a pending CLI permission request. Deciding requires a global admin or a tenant admin of the request's tenant, or the mission or thread owner when Permissions.AllowOwnerApproval is on. Requires a credential (not the unauthenticated loopback identity) and is refused for captain sessions, so a captain can never approve its own prompt.

mcp.name: delete_ask_thread
mcp.description: Permanently delete an Ask Armada conversation and its messages, cancelling its turn if one is running. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_ask_threads
mcp.description: Permanently delete up to 1000 Ask Armada conversations by ID (cancelling running turns); more is InvalidArgument CollectionLimitExceeded. Returns which were deleted and which were not found (both bounded by the request). This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_backlog_item
mcp.description: Delete one backlog item and its snapshot history.

mcp.name: delete_blackbox_entries
mcp.description: Delete black box entries by id (entryIds, at most 1000; more is InvalidArgument with Code CollectionLimitExceeded before anything is deleted). Ids that are missing or not visible are skipped. Tenant admins and global admins only. This cannot be undone: pin entries you want to keep instead.

mcp.name: delete_captain
mcp.description: Delete a captain. If working, the captain is recalled first.

mcp.name: delete_captains
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple captains from the database by ID. Captains that are Working or have active missions are skipped. At most 1000 ids (InvalidArgument, Code CollectionLimitExceeded, otherwise). Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_cli_permission_rule
mcp.description: Delete a CLI permission rule (admins of the rule's tenant).

mcp.name: delete_dock
mcp.description: Delete a dock and clean up its git worktree. Blocked if the dock is actively in use by a captain.

mcp.name: delete_docks
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple docks and their git worktrees from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_event
mcp.description: Delete a single event by ID. Permanently removes the event from the database.

mcp.name: delete_events
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple events from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_failure_cause_rule
mcp.description: Delete a failure-cause rule. Rules for every tenant and built-in rules need a global admin. A deleted built-in rule is stored again the next time the Admiral starts; disable it (enabled false) to keep it out of classification.

mcp.name: delete_fleet
mcp.description: Delete a fleet by ID

mcp.name: delete_fleet_action
mcp.description: Delete a fleet action. Built-in actions are soft-deleted and never re-seeded. Past runs are kept.

mcp.name: delete_fleets
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple fleets from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Delete a Harbor registration by ID.

mcp.name: delete_memory
mcp.description: Delete a memory by id. Use this to remove a memory that has become stale or is no longer relevant.

mcp.name: delete_merge
mcp.description: Permanently delete a terminal merge queue entry from the database. Only entries in Landed, Failed, or Cancelled status can be deleted. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_missions
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple missions from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Delete a managed model endpoint by ID.

mcp.name: delete_objective
mcp.description: Delete one objective/backlog entry and its snapshot history.

mcp.name: delete_persona
mcp.description: Delete a persona by name. Built-in personas cannot be deleted.

mcp.name: delete_pipeline
mcp.description: Delete a pipeline by name. Built-in pipelines cannot be deleted.

mcp.name: delete_playbook
mcp.description: Delete a playbook by ID. Existing mission snapshots remain immutable.

mcp.name: delete_signals
mcp.description: Soft-delete multiple signals by marking them as read. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries.

mcp.name: delete_vessel
mcp.description: Delete a vessel by ID. Returns status, vesselId, warningCount, and (when cleanup left anything behind) the first 50 warnings.

mcp.name: delete_vessels
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple vessels from the database by ID. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_voyages
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple voyages and their associated missions from the database by ID. Voyages that are Open/InProgress or have active missions are skipped. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: delete_workflow_profile
mcp.description: Delete a workflow profile by ID. This cannot be undone. Tenant admins only, as over REST.

mcp.name: delete_workflow_profiles
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple workflow profiles by ID. Ids that are missing, outside your scope, or not editable by you are skipped with a reason. Returns a summary of deleted and skipped entries. This cannot be undone. Tenant admins only, as over REST.

mcp.name: deny_mission_review
mcp.description: Deny a mission waiting at a pipeline review gate (status Review). RetryStage runs the stage again on the same branch with the comment added to its instructions; FailPipeline fails the mission and cancels the following stages. Without action the stage's configured deny action applies. Refused for captain sessions.

mcp.name: diff_blackbox_entries
mcp.description: Compare two black box entries (two attempts of a mission, or any two you can see): what differs in captain, runtime, model, persona, status, phase and step, Armada version, failure kind and fingerprint, base commit and target tips, every effective configuration value, and the files each mission changed. At most 100 differences and 200 files per side.

mcp.name: discover_vessels
mcp.description: Discover git repositories on the Admiral host to onboard as vessels. Scans the given directories and roots (breadth-first, skipping excluded and dot-prefixed folders, worktrees, and Armada's own directories) and saves the result as an import batch. Creates no vessels; call import_vessels with the returned batchId to import. Requires tenant admin. Paths must be inside Import.AllowedRoots (or the user profile when none are configured).

mcp.name: dispatch
mcp.description: Dispatch a new voyage with missions to a vessel

mcp.name: dispatch_backlog_planning_session
mcp.description: Dispatch a voyage from a planning session and link it to every backlog item linked to the session. Returns the voyage and linkedObjectiveCount; list the items with list_backlog filtered by voyageId.

mcp.name: draft_failure_cause_rule
mcp.description: Draft (without storing) a failure-cause rule from a classified stage outcome: its cause and tenant, priority 5, and a match on its failure kind, runtime failure kind, stage-check status and reason, disposition and persona. Edit the draft and pass it to create_failure_cause_rule.

mcp.name: duplicate_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Create an edited copy of an editable endpoint. Omitted apiKey and null extra-header values inherit stored secrets server-side; secrets are never returned. Does not call the provider.

mcp.name: enqueue_merge
mcp.description: Add a branch to the merge queue for testing and merging

mcp.name: enumerate
mcp.description: Find and browse entities with paginated, filtered, sorted access to: inbox (the needs-you items, most urgent first), cli_permission_rules, cli_permission_requests, objectives, fleets, vessels, captains, missions, voyages, docks, signals, events, merge_queue, personas, prompt_templates, pipelines, playbooks, workflow_profiles, project_profiles, skills, check_runs, releases, deployments, incidents, runbooks, runbook_executions, vessel_import_batch, fleet_action, fleet_action_run, fleet_action_run_target, vessel_health, and blackbox (black box entry summaries, newest first). Returns paginated results with total counts. Filter by vesselId, fleetId, captainId, voyageId, status, date range, and more.

mcp.name: evaluate_autoland
mcp.description: Dry-run the vessel's auto-land predicate against a mission's captured diff without landing it. Returns whether the change would auto-land and, if not, the hold reason.

mcp.name: evaluate_captain
mcp.description: Start a Quick Evaluate: probe-only mechanical probes (output contract, served context, ASCII and format rules, tool calling, speed, determinism) through the captain's own runtime, or through the API endpoint runtime for a model endpoint. Give exactly one of captainId or modelEndpointId. Returns the queued run at once; poll get_model_probe_run. Probes record observations; a probe a runtime cannot run is CouldNotRun with the reason. Nothing changes routing or captain settings. Evaluating a captain needs a global admin or a tenant admin of its tenant; evaluating an endpoint needs read access to it. Depth Full is not implemented until Phase 5.

mcp.name: evaluate_vessel_health
mcp.description: Start a background vessel health evaluation job for specific vessels, a fleet, or every active vessel. Returns jobId; alreadyRunning is true (and nothing starts) when an evaluation is already running for the tenant. Poll the job with enumerate entityType jobs or GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: export_blackbox_fixture
mcp.description: Export a black box entry as a sanitized regression fixture (record without secrets, tenant and user ids, host paths or repository URL, plus the rule ids and triage the advisor produces now), to add under src/Test.Shared/Fixtures/BlackBox with a test. Global admins only. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: fleet_action_run_status
mcp.description: Get a fleet action run with its target counts (succeeded, failed, skipped, cancelled). Targets are not embedded: page them with enumerate (entityType fleet_action_run_target, runId, pageNumber, pageSize, optional status) for per-target status, reason codes, exit code, voyage id and output length hints.

mcp.name: get_ask_thread
mcp.description: Get one Ask Armada conversation with counts of its tracked work, pending proposals, and pending CLI permission requests, and the running turn's progress (with its tool call count). Read the collections with list_ask_work, list_ask_proposals, and list_ask_tool_calls.

mcp.name: get_ask_work
mcp.description: Get the current state of work an Ask Armada conversation is tracking (a voyage, mission, or fleet action run it started): status and counts, with missionCount and targetCount. Read the rows with list_ask_work_missions and list_ask_work_targets.

mcp.name: get_backlog_item
mcp.description: Inspect one backlog item including linked repositories, planning sessions, voyages, releases, deployments, incidents, and acceptance criteria.

mcp.name: get_backlog_planning_session
mcp.description: Inspect one planning session created from backlog/objective work: the session, its captain and vessel, messageCount, and linkedObjectiveCount. Read the transcript with list_backlog_planning_session_messages and the linked items with list_backlog filtered by planningSessionId.

mcp.name: get_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Inspect one backlog refinement session: the session, its captain, vessel, and linked backlog item, and messageCount. Read the transcript with list_backlog_refinement_session_messages.

mcp.name: get_battery_run
mcp.description: Get one fixture battery run visible to the caller: its provenance (seed, sampling settings, battery version, configuration revision) and outcome counts. The per-task results are not embedded: page them with list_battery_results.

mcp.name: get_blackbox
mcp.description: Get the black box of a failed mission or voyage: start here when asked why something failed. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry. format summary (default, about 2 KB) returns where it failed (phase, step, host, source file and method), how (mechanism), status before and after, why (top findings), the triage verdict and confidence (TriageSuspected when only the handoff and landing prior voted ArmadaDefect), the Armada resilience angle (ResilienceInScope, SelfHealable, SelfHealingProposal, DetectionGap, ResilienceSeverity and TopProposedChange: for a handoff or landing failure, first ask whether Armada could have handled it) and the top recovery paths; brief returns the Markdown FIX THIS brief; json returns the full record. Then read only the sections the question needs with read_blackbox_section and page evidence with read_blackbox_object. NotFound (Code BlackBoxNotFound) when there is no entry.

mcp.name: get_blackbox_bundle
mcp.description: Build a maintainer bundle: up to max (1-50, default 50) of the newest matching black box entries grouped by fingerprint (highest resilience severity first, then most frequent), as one Markdown document with the brief, proposed Armada changes and regression test of each failure mode (format Markdown, default) or JSON summaries. By default it holds the Armada resilience gaps (handoff and landing scope, triaged ArmadaDefect); set allFailures, triage or resilienceScope to choose other entries. Use it to produce Armada missions on the Armada vessel. redactHosts strips absolute paths, host names and user names before sharing outside the installation.

mcp.name: get_blackbox_fingerprint_trend
mcp.description: Get the trend of one black box failure mode: occurrences of the fingerprint per Armada version (ordered by first sighting, with open and ArmadaFixed counts; at most 1000 entries and 100 versions), to see whether a release fixed it.

mcp.name: get_blackbox_recovery_stats
mcp.description: Get one page of black box recovery path statistics over the confirmed recovery runs you can see: per rule and path, runs, succeeded (the mission completed afterwards), failed, pending, expired and successRate; most runs first. The advisor breaks ties between equally weighted recovery paths with these rates.

mcp.name: get_blackbox_retention
mcp.description: Get the black box retention status: the policy, entry counts (total, pinned, deleting, expired), bytes, the next garbage collection run and the last run's report. Tenant admins see their tenant; global admins every tenant.

mcp.name: get_blackbox_storage
mcp.description: Get the black box storage status: the configured target, its health, whether writes fall back to the database, and bytes per target. Global admins only.

mcp.name: get_blackbox_timeline
mcp.description: Get one page of a black box entry's combined timeline: the entry (captured, enriched, analyzed, resolved) and its notes, the mission or voyage and their events, the dock, the merge queue entry, the captain's events in the mission's window and the Harbor link events, in one order (oldest first unless order is CreatedDescending). Each source is capped at 200 items and the timeline at 1000; sources and truncated say where a cut applied.

mcp.name: get_captain
mcp.description: Get details of a specific captain (AI agent)

mcp.name: get_captain_log
mcp.description: Get the current session log for a captain. Supports pagination.

mcp.name: get_captain_tools
mcp.description: Describe the runtime-visible tool sources (at most 256) and tool counts of a specific captain, with one page of its named tools (Tools: pageNumber, pageSize 1 to 1000 default 10, ordered by source kind, source, and name). A snapshot from the last 60 seconds is reused for paging unless refresh is true.

mcp.name: get_check_run
mcp.description: Inspect one structured check run including status, output, artifacts, parsed test summary, and coverage summary.

mcp.name: get_cli_permission_request
mcp.description: Get one CLI permission request visible to the caller.

mcp.name: get_deployment
mcp.description: Inspect one deployment including approval, verification, rollback, linked checks, and request-history evidence.

mcp.name: get_dock
mcp.description: Get a dock (git worktree) by ID.

mcp.name: get_failure_cause_rule
mcp.description: Get one failure-cause rule visible to the caller.

mcp.name: get_fleet
mcp.description: Get one fleet and its vessel count (VesselCount). Vessels are not embedded: page them with enumerate entityType vessels and fleetId.

mcp.name: get_handoff_artifact
mcp.description: Get the complete handoff artifact of a stage attempt: numbered findings (file, line, severity, required fix), acceptance criteria, required actions, check results (passed, failed, skipped with reason, could not run), commit references, the full stage output and the full diff (or where to regenerate it). The prior-stage section of a mission brief names the artifact id.

mcp.name: get_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Inspect one registered Harbor (host runner) by ID, including its advertised capabilities and connection status.

mcp.name: get_harbor_metrics
mcp.description: [Experimental] Charts for one Harbor over a window: jobs finished and failed per bucket (missions and other launches apart), slot usage (peak and average concurrent jobs against capacity), launch speed per runtime (median and p95 time to first output and total runtime), link health (connected, reconnecting, and down stretches and heartbeat round-trip times), and token usage by runtime and model. range is 1h (1-minute buckets), 24h (30-minute buckets, default), or 7d (3-hour buckets).

mcp.name: get_memory
mcp.description: Read a single memory by id, including its full content.

mcp.name: get_merge_entry
mcp.description: Get details of a specific merge queue entry

mcp.name: get_mission_diff
mcp.description: Get the git diff of changes made by a captain for a mission. Returns saved diff if available, otherwise live worktree diff.

mcp.name: get_mission_log
mcp.description: Get the session log for a mission. Supports pagination.

mcp.name: get_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Inspect one managed model endpoint (embedding or inference) by ID. The API key is never returned.

mcp.name: get_model_probe_run
mcp.description: Get one Evaluate run visible to the caller, with its per-probe results (Pass, Fail, or CouldNotRun with the reason) and the observations each probe recorded.

mcp.name: get_model_profile
mcp.description: Get one model profile visible to the caller (the model as served: runtime, provider, model and served context) with its capabilities, rendering overrides, notes and immutable revisions (runtime version, model digest, sampling, tool configuration, compatibleWith, firstSeenUtc), oldest first. Profiles are advisory: they do not set a captain's tier or change routing. A captain's modelProfileId points at its profile.

mcp.name: get_objective
mcp.description: Inspect one objective including linked repositories, planning sessions, voyages, releases, deployments, incidents, and acceptance criteria.

mcp.name: get_persona
mcp.description: Get a persona by name

mcp.name: get_pipeline
mcp.description: Get a pipeline by name, including its stages

mcp.name: get_playbook
mcp.description: Get a playbook by ID.

mcp.name: get_prompt_template
mcp.description: Get a prompt template by name. Resolves from database first, falls back to embedded defaults.

mcp.name: get_release
mcp.description: Inspect one release record including linked voyages, missions, checks, versions, tags, notes, and derived artifacts.

mcp.name: get_runbook
mcp.description: Inspect one runbook including parameters, bound workflow profile, environment, and step structure.

mcp.name: get_runbook_execution
mcp.description: Inspect one runbook execution including completed steps, notes, and deployment or incident linkage.

mcp.name: get_stage_outcome
mcp.description: Get one stage outcome visible to the caller.

mcp.name: get_vessel
mcp.description: Get details of a specific vessel (repository)

mcp.name: get_vessel_blackbox_doctor
mcp.description: Get a vessel's black box configuration doctor: the configuration recommendations that recur across its black box entries in a window (windowDays 1 to 365, default 30), one row per rule and setting with count, first and last seen, the suggested value and the newest entry as the example (apply it with apply_blackbox_recommendation). Most frequent first, paged; the newest 200 entries are read (entriesScanned, scanTruncated).

mcp.name: get_voyage_blackbox_cascade
mcp.description: Get a voyage's black box cascade graph: its missions (status, failure kind, current black box entry; at most 200) and the edges between them (DependsOn, CancelledBecause, BlockedBy, Sibling), with the cascade root (the earliest failure with no failed dependency) and its entry. Use it to see which failure took the others down.

mcp.name: get_workflow_profile
mcp.description: Get a workflow profile by ID, including every command stage checks run (build, unit test, integration, e2e, migration, security scan, performance, package, release, deploy verification) and its environments.

mcp.name: health_check_model_endpoints
mcp.description: Run a health sweep across all enabled model endpoints, deduplicated by base URL, and refresh their health status. Returns the number of distinct base URLs probed.

mcp.name: import_vessels
mcp.description: Import candidates from a discover_vessels batch as vessels. Pass the candidate paths to import, or allNew=true to import every candidate with status New. Each vessel gets RepoUrl = origin URL (or the local path), WorkingDirectory = the discovered path, and no LocalPath. Paths that already have a vessel are skipped. Large selections run as a background job (returns jobId; poll the batch with enumerate entityType vessel_import_batch or get the job). Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: lint_mission_brief
mcp.description: Lint a mission brief before dispatch: BRIEF-DEP-001 dependency language ("after mission 2 lands", "depends on", "mission N") without dependsOnMissionId, BRIEF-NOOP-001 a verification-only brief that is likely to fail as NoOp, BRIEF-PATH-001 a path whose top-level directory the vessel does not have (needs vesselId), BRIEF-PATH-002 a host or parent-relative path. At most 50 findings with a suggestion each. Warnings only; dispatch runs the same lint and never refuses a brief.

mcp.name: list_ask_messages
mcp.description: Read an Ask Armada conversation's messages, newest page first (1 to 200 per page). Pass beforeSequence (the lowest sequence you have) to read older messages. Each message carries toolCallCount; read its tool calls with list_ask_tool_calls.

mcp.name: list_ask_proposals
mcp.description: Read one page of an Ask Armada conversation's action proposals (paged in the database), newest first by default. status filters by proposal status, for example Pending.

mcp.name: list_ask_quick_actions
mcp.description: List the quick actions an Ask Armada conversation can run directly (each is an Armada tool with its argument form).

mcp.name: list_ask_threads
mcp.description: List the caller's Ask Armada conversations, newest first, with titles, captain, pinned and archived state, and unread counts. Use search to match titles and includeArchived to include archived ones.

mcp.name: list_ask_tool_calls
mcp.description: Read one page of tool calls in an Ask Armada conversation: the calls of one message (messageId, paged in the database), or without messageId the calls the running turn has made so far. Newest first by default; pass order CreatedAscending for the order they were made in.

mcp.name: list_ask_work
mcp.description: Read one page of the work an Ask Armada conversation tracks (paged in the database), newest first by default, each item with a counts-only snapshot. status filters by state: Active, Succeeded, Failed, or Cancelled.

mcp.name: list_ask_work_missions
mcp.description: Read one page of the mission rows of tracked work (a voyage's missions, or the mission itself), paged in the database. Newest first by default; pass order CreatedAscending for creation order. Fleet action runs have targets instead (list_ask_work_targets).

mcp.name: list_ask_work_targets
mcp.description: Read one page of the target rows of a tracked fleet action run (one per vessel, by vessel name), paged in the database.

mcp.name: list_backlog
mcp.description: Enumerate backlog items with optional vessel, fleet, status, backlog-state, priority, and free-text filters.

mcp.name: list_backlog_planning_session_messages
mcp.description: Read one page of a planning session's transcript (paged in the database). Newest first by default; pass order CreatedAscending for oldest first. totalRecords is the transcript length.

mcp.name: list_backlog_refinement_session_messages
mcp.description: Read one page of a backlog refinement session's transcript (paged in the database). Newest first by default; pass order CreatedAscending for oldest first. totalRecords is the transcript length.

mcp.name: list_backlog_refinement_sessions
mcp.description: List captain-backed refinement sessions for one backlog item, one page at a time (paged in the database). Returns session metadata only, most-recently-updated first; read a session's transcript with list_backlog_refinement_session_messages.

mcp.name: list_battery_packs
mcp.description: List the fixture battery packs (each a fixture repository plus its tasks, defined as data), with each task's persona, grader (command, byteComparison, seededSet, mutation, rubric) and toolchain. Malformed packs are listed with valid false and their validation errors. Returns an enumeration result (objects, totalRecords, totalPages).

mcp.name: list_battery_results
mcp.description: List one page of a fixture battery run's per-task results (Passed, Failed, CouldNotRun or PendingEvaluation), each with the grader's evidence and the captain's raw output. Paged in the database; returns an enumeration result (objects, totalRecords, totalPages).

mcp.name: list_blackbox_entries
mcp.description: List one page of black box entries visible to the caller, newest first, filtered by vesselId, voyageId, missionId, captainId, fleetId, phase, step, kind, triage, resolution, state, fingerprint (compare failures of the same mode), pinned, isCurrent, path (any file role), resilienceScope (true for Armada's handoff and landing failures) and createdAfter/createdBefore. Returns an enumeration result of entry summaries.

mcp.name: list_blackbox_fingerprints
mcp.description: List one page of black box failure modes (entries grouped by fingerprint) with count, open count, first and last seen, the newest entry and its phase, step and kind. Filter by vesselId, resolution and createdAfter/createdBefore. Compare one mode's entries with list_blackbox_entries {fingerprint}.

mcp.name: list_blackbox_hotspots
mcp.description: List one page of black box hotspots: directories that recur in failures (conflicted, dirty, out of scope), most entries first, with file and entry counts and when last seen. Filter by vesselId, role and createdAfter/createdBefore.

mcp.name: list_blackbox_nearby_successes
mcp.description: List one page of the successful landings near a failure (success flight recorder): same vessel, within blackBox.nearbySuccessWindowHours of the failure, that changed files the failure also touched; most overlap first, then closest in time. Each has the mission, landed time, hours from the failure, base and landed commits, run time and the overlapping files.

mcp.name: list_blackbox_notes
mcp.description: List one page of the notes on a black box entry (operator, agent, Ask Armada and system annotations, including what every recovery run did), newest first. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: list_blackbox_objects
mcp.description: List one page of a black box entry's objects (record.json, the briefs and evidence such as evidence/git-status.txt or evidence/diff.patch) with content type, sizes and SHA-256. Read one with read_blackbox_object. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: list_blackbox_resilience_gaps
mcp.description: List one page of Armada resilience gaps: failure modes (fingerprints) in Armada's own handoff and landing that the black box triaged ArmadaDefect, most severe first within the page, each with occurrences, open count, first and last seen, the Armada versions it was seen in, the severity (escalated by recurrence), whether Armada could have healed it (selfHealable), whether the verdict is only suspected, the detection gap and the top proposed Armada change, and the newest entry. Page size 1-50. Filter by vesselId, resolution, phase and createdAfter/createdBefore. Use it to pick the Armada missions that make handoff and landing more resilient.

mcp.name: list_failure_cause_rules
mcp.description: List the failure-cause rules visible to the caller in evaluation order (priority ascending, then name), one page at a time: the caller's tenant plus the rules for every tenant, built-in rules included. The first enabled matching rule assigns a stage outcome's suspected cause.

mcp.name: list_handoff_artifacts
mcp.description: List the handoff artifacts of a mission (one per stage attempt), newest first, one page at a time. Output and diff text are left out (their lengths stay); use get_handoff_artifact for them. Returns an enumeration result (objects, totalRecords, totalPages).

mcp.name: list_harbor_jobs
mcp.description: [Experimental] One page of the captain launches recorded on a Harbor, newest first: job ID, mission, captain, runtime, launch and end times, outcome, and whether a stop was requested. openOnly lists only jobs that have not ended; use it to find an agent left running after its mission was cancelled.

mcp.name: list_model_probe_runs
mcp.description: List Evaluate runs, newest first, one page at a time, without their per-probe results. A global admin sees every tenant; everyone else sees their own tenant. Returns an enumeration result (objects, totalRecords, totalPages).

mcp.name: list_model_profiles
mcp.description: List model profiles, newest first, one page at a time, without their revisions. A global admin sees every tenant; everyone else sees their own tenant. Returns an enumeration result (objects, totalRecords, totalPages).

mcp.name: list_objectives
mcp.description: Enumerate backlog objectives with optional vessel, fleet, status, backlog-state, priority, and free-text filters.

mcp.name: list_prompt_templates
mcp.description: List prompt templates (lightweight, paginated), optionally filtered by category. Returns metadata only -- name, category, description, active flag, and a contentLength hint -- not the template body. Fetch a single template's full content with get_prompt_template.

mcp.name: list_stage_outcomes
mcp.description: List stage outcomes (one per stage attempt: who ran it, what was observed, what Armada did next, and the suspected cause of a shortfall), newest first, one page at a time. A global admin sees every tenant; everyone else sees their own tenant. Returns an enumeration result (objects, totalRecords, totalPages).

mcp.name: list_vessel_dependencies
mcp.description: List one page of a vessel's outdated or vulnerable dependency rows from its last health evaluation (ecosystem, packageName, projectPath, currentVersion, latestVersion, drift, isVulnerable, severity, advisoryUrl), ordered by ecosystem, package name, then project path. Returns the standard page shape (objects, pageNumber, pageSize, totalPages, totalRecords).

mcp.name: list_vessel_reservations
mcp.description: List one page of a vessel's soft directory reservations: active missions whose scoped files sit in a directory the black box marks as a conflict hotspot (threshold blackBox.hotspotReservationThreshold; 0 turns reservations off). A mission dispatched into a reserved directory is warned, or chained after the reserving mission when the vessel has serializeOverlappingMissions. Ordered by directory then mission id; returns the page shape plus threshold, hotDirectoryCount, activeMissionsScanned and scanTruncated.

mcp.name: list_voyage_progress
mcp.description: Page through voyages with their mission counts (the voyages the status tool counts in ActiveVoyages). With no status the view is the active voyages: InProgress first, then Open, newest first within each. A status selects one voyage status. Returns PageNumber, PageSize, TotalPages, TotalRecords, and Objects (VoyageProgress).

mcp.name: mark_ask_thread_read
mcp.description: Mark an Ask Armada conversation as read (clears its unread count).

mcp.name: mission_status
mcp.description: Get status of a specific mission. LastBlackBoxEntryId names its current black box entry when it failed (read it with get_blackbox).

mcp.name: papercut_summary
mcp.description: List friction that captains reported during missions, collapsed into groups of the same vessel, category, and problem. Use the count and distinct-captain count to tell a one-off from a real defect, then promote a group to a backlog item or objective.

mcp.name: pin_blackbox
mcp.description: Pin (pinned true, the default) or unpin (pinned false) a black box entry. Garbage collection never deletes a pinned entry. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: preview_mission_overlap
mcp.description: Before dispatching a mission, preview what it would overlap on a vessel: its likely files (scoped-files directive plus repository paths in the brief that exist in the vessel), the active missions whose files it shares, black box conflict hotspots and directories reserved by active missions, strongest first (at most 50), the mission dispatch would chain it after when the vessel has serializeOverlappingMissions (suggestedDependsOnMissionId), and the brief lint findings. Read-only: nothing is dispatched. dispatch and create_mission return the same warnings as overlapWarnings.

mcp.name: preview_workflow_profile
mcp.description: Preview the workflow commands a vessel would run: resolves the profile as resolve_workflow_profile does and returns resolvedProfile, resolutionMode, availableCheckTypes, and commandPreviews.

mcp.name: process_merge_entry
mcp.description: Process a single merge queue entry by ID: creates integration branch, runs tests, and lands if passing

mcp.name: process_merge_queue
mcp.description: Process the merge queue: creates integration branches, runs tests, and lands passing batches

mcp.name: purge_blackbox
mcp.description: Purge black box entries by filter (the list_blackbox_entries filters), oldest first, up to maxEntries (1-100000, default 10000). dryRun defaults to true and reports what would go (matched, a sample of ids, bytes) without deleting; pinned entries are skipped unless includePinned. Run the dry run, show the user the counts, and only then purge with dryRun false. Global admins only.

mcp.name: purge_dock
mcp.description: Force purge a dock and its git worktree, even if a mission references it. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_merge_entries
mcp.description: Permanently delete multiple terminal merge queue entries from the database by ID. Only entries in Landed, Failed, or Cancelled status can be purged. Returns a summary of purged and skipped entries. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_merge_entry
mcp.description: Permanently delete a single terminal merge queue entry from the database by ID. Only entries in Landed, Failed, or Cancelled status can be purged. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_merge_queue
mcp.description: Permanently delete all terminal merge queue entries (Landed, Failed, Cancelled) from the database. Optionally filter by vessel ID and/or status. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_mission
mcp.description: Permanently delete a mission from the database. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: purge_voyage
mcp.description: Permanently delete a voyage and all its missions from the database. This cannot be undone.

mcp.name: read_blackbox_object
mcp.description: Read a chunk of one black box object without flooding context: at most 64 KB per call (length 1 to 65536, default 65536) from offset (default 0). Returns content (UTF-8 text for text objects, base64 otherwise, cut at a character boundary), totalBytes, and nextOffset while more remains; call again with offset = nextOffset to page through a large log. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: read_blackbox_section
mcp.description: Read one section of a black box record: Subject, Status, Site, Mechanism, Classification, Workspace (dirty paths, checkout), Conflict (conflicted files and the missions that landed them), Scope, Configuration (each setting and where it came from), Attempts, Evidence (the object index), Analysis (findings, triage, recovery paths, recommendations), Resilience (whether Armada could have healed it, the detection gap, code pointers, proposed Armada changes as mission briefs, the regression test), Handoff (the handoff and landing step timeline, the automatic recoveries Armada already tried, dock transitions, target movement), Related, Voyage, Redaction or Truncation. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: reanalyze_blackbox
mcp.description: Re-run enrichment and analysis of a black box entry with the current rules (rewrites record.json and the briefs). Tenant admins and global admins only. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: reclassify_stage_outcomes
mcp.description: Re-apply the enabled failure-cause rules to every stage outcome matching the filter (paging is ignored), so a new or edited rule takes effect on past attempts; outcomes classified by hand are left alone. Global admins and tenant admins (their own tenant) only. Returns examined, changed and skippedManual.

mcp.name: reject_ask_proposal
mcp.description: Reject an action Armada proposed in an Ask Armada conversation; it does not run.

mcp.name: release_captain
mcp.description: Lift a captain's quarantine, returning it to the Idle pool so tier selection can hand it work again.

mcp.name: reorder_backlog_items
mcp.description: Apply one or more explicit backlog rank updates using backlog terminology.

mcp.name: reorder_objectives
mcp.description: Apply one or more explicit backlog rank updates using objective-compatible tool naming.

mcp.name: repair_dock
mcp.description: Repair a dock's git worktree to fix a corrupted or relocated registration. Non-destructive: no work is removed.

mcp.name: reset_prompt_template
mcp.description: Reset a prompt template to its embedded resource default content. Only works for built-in templates.

mcp.name: resolve_blackbox
mcp.description: Set a black box entry's resolution (Open, Resolved, Duplicate, WontFix or ArmadaFixed) with an optional note (up to 2000 characters) and link (for example the landed commit or a pull request, up to 1000). Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: resolve_workflow_profile
mcp.description: Resolve the workflow profile that applies to a vessel: an explicit workflowProfileId when given, otherwise the vessel's assigned profile, then vessel, fleet, and global precedence. Returns the profile.

mcp.name: restart_mission
mcp.description: Restart a Failed, LandingFailed, or Cancelled mission, resetting it to Pending for re-dispatch, or start a Pending mission as it is. A later pipeline stage keeps the previous stage's branch, a finished voyage is reopened, and the stages cancelled because this one failed are restored. The mission is then dispatched at once when a captain is available; otherwise it stays Pending for the regular dispatcher. Optionally update title and description (instructions) before restarting.

mcp.name: restore
mcp.description: Restore the Armada database and settings from a ZIP backup file. Creates a safety backup of the current state before overwriting. Server restart recommended after restore.

mcp.name: retry_check_run
mcp.description: Retry a previously completed structured check run using the same resolved scope and command context.

mcp.name: retry_landing
mcp.description: Retry landing for a mission in LandingFailed status. Rebases the mission branch onto the current target and re-attempts landing.

mcp.name: rollback_deployment
mcp.description: Run the configured rollback flow for an existing deployment.

mcp.name: run_ask_quick_action
mcp.description: Propose a quick action in an Ask Armada conversation (toolName from list_ask_quick_actions, with its arguments). It becomes an action proposal that runs when approved, or at once when the conversation auto-approves.

mcp.name: run_battery
mcp.description: Run fixture battery packs against a captain. Before each task the fixture is reset; the task is dispatched as a mission on the pack's fixture vessel under the built-in ModelEvaluation pipeline (pinned to the captain, no landing) and graded per its manifest. Returns the queued run at once; poll get_battery_run. runCount defaults to 3. A task whose toolchain the Harbor lacks is CouldNotRun, never Failed; rubric-graded tasks are PendingEvaluation. Battery missions never count in production stage outcomes. Needs a global admin or a tenant admin of the captain's tenant. Set createFixtureVessel to create a pack's fixture vessel the first time.

mcp.name: run_blackbox_gc
mcp.description: Run one black box garbage collection pass now (expiry, quotas, cascades, retried deletes, orphan sweep) and return its report; dryRun true lists the candidates without deleting. Global admins only.

mcp.name: run_blackbox_recovery
mcp.description: Run one recovery path recorded in a black box entry's analysis (pathId, for example bbx-land-001.stash-retry). It never takes a free-form command: only the steps recorded in the entry run, each authorized as if you had called that tool directly. Always dry run first (dryRun defaults to true): the dry run returns the plan and a confirmToken (10 minutes, bound to the entry, the path and the mission's current version, so a mission that changed must be re-checked). Tell the user what will happen, then run with dryRun false and that confirmToken. A path marked dataLossRisk (deleting a branch, forcing a dock reclaim) is refused without acknowledgeDataLoss true; confirm with the user before setting it. Every dry run and run is annotated on the entry (authorKind Agent). A token is single use; a missing, expired, used or foreign token, a mission that changed, or a re-analyzed plan is Conflict with Code BlackBoxConfirmationRequired: dry run again. A step whose precondition is not met (restart_mission on a mission that is already Pending, retry_landing on one that is not LandingFailed, a deleted dock) is refused: refused true and unmetPreconditions name it, a refused dry run has no confirmToken and a refused confirmed run runs nothing. Read the black box summary first. Quote evidence, not guesses. State the triage verdict and whether you agree. If you act, use only recovery paths or recommendations from the entry, do a dry run, tell the user what will happen, and confirm before running anything marked dataLossRisk. Annotate the entry with what you did. Name the entry with entryId (bbx_ prefix), or with missionId or voyageId for that mission's or voyage's current entry.

mcp.name: run_check
mcp.description: Start a structured check run for a vessel using the resolved workflow profile or an explicit command override.

mcp.name: run_fleet_action
mcp.description: Start a fleet action run over vessels. Pass actionId to run a saved action, or the inline definition fields (name, kind, commandText or promptTemplate) for an ad hoc run. Every vessel must be in the caller's tenant or the whole request is rejected. Returns the run id; poll fleet_action_run_status.

mcp.name: search_blackbox
mcp.description: Full-text search over the reason, summary and notes of the black box entries visible to the caller (query 1 to 200 characters), with the same filters and paging as list_blackbox_entries. Returns an enumeration result of entry summaries.

mcp.name: search_memory
mcp.description: Search durable memories (episodic/semantic/procedural). Use this BEFORE writing to find existing memories to consolidate against. Returns matches ordered by salience, newest first.

mcp.name: send_ask_message
mcp.description: Send a message in an Ask Armada conversation; its captain answers in the background. Set waitSeconds (up to 600) to wait for the reply and get the latest messages back; otherwise read the reply later with list_ask_messages. Fails with Conflict while a turn is already running.

mcp.name: send_backlog_refinement_message
mcp.description: Append one user message to a backlog refinement session and launch the next captain turn.

mcp.name: send_signal
mcp.description: Send a signal/message to a captain

mcp.name: set_captain_cli_permission_policy
mcp.description: Set or clear a captain's CLI tool permission policy (Refuse, ApproveInArmada, or Bypass; omit policy to inherit). Requires a global admin or a tenant admin of the captain's tenant. Bypass runs the CLI with its permission-bypass flag (for example --dangerously-skip-permissions): the captain can run any command as the Admiral's user.

mcp.name: set_harbor_enabled
mcp.description: [Experimental] Enable or disable a Harbor for routing. A disabled Harbor keeps its docks but receives no new missions.

mcp.name: set_vessel_health_override
mcp.description: Set (or with remove=true, remove) a manual status override for one vessel health criterion, or for Overall. Effective statuses are recomputed immediately from stored findings. Requires tenant admin.

mcp.name: start_runbook_execution
mcp.description: Start a guided runbook execution with optional parameter overrides and deployment or incident context.

mcp.name: status
mcp.description: Get aggregate status of active work in Armada: captain counts by state, mission counts by status, active voyage counts (ActiveVoyages, InProgressVoyages, OpenVoyages), and the 10 most recent signals. Page through the active voyages with progress with list_voyage_progress. A global administrator sees every tenant; any other caller sees only its own tenant.

mcp.name: stop_all
mcp.description: Emergency stop all running captains

mcp.name: stop_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Request stop for one active backlog refinement session and release the selected captain.

mcp.name: stop_captain
mcp.description: Stop a specific captain agent, killing its process and recalling it to idle state

mcp.name: stop_harbor_job
mcp.description: [Experimental] Ask a connected Harbor to stop one job by ID (from list_harbor_jobs), for an agent no mission or captain still points at. Returns Requested (sent; the Harbor reports the exit), AlreadyEnded, HarborNotConnected, or NotFound.

mcp.name: stop_server
mcp.description: Initiate a graceful shutdown of the Admiral server

mcp.name: summarize_ask_thread
mcp.description: Ask the conversation's captain to summarize the conversation so far (runs as a turn in the background).

mcp.name: summarize_backlog_refinement_session
mcp.description: Create or select a structured backlog-refinement summary from one refinement session.

mcp.name: token_usage_summary
mcp.description: Summarize model token usage over a time window: time buckets with a per-model breakdown, a whole-window per-model aggregate ordered most-used first, and grand totals (input, output, cached, total). Counts are real where the runtime reports usage (for example Claude Code) and estimated otherwise; estimatedCount reports how many aggregated records were estimated. At most 1000 buckets: a window and bucketMinutes that would produce more fails with InvalidArgument (Code CollectionLimitExceeded). byModel and each bucket's models list the modelLimit most-used models; the rest are summed into otherModels (otherModelCount says how many).

mcp.name: transition_mission_status
mcp.description: Transition a mission to a new status with validation (the same rules as PUT /api/v1/missions/{id}/status). Valid transitions: Pending->Assigned/Cancelled/Blocked, Assigned->InProgress/Cancelled, InProgress->WorkProduced/Testing/Review/Complete/Failed/Cancelled, WorkProduced->PullRequestOpen/Complete/LandingFailed/Cancelled, PullRequestOpen->Complete/LandingFailed/Cancelled, Testing->InProgress/Review/Complete/Failed, Review->InProgress/Complete/Failed, LandingFailed->WorkProduced/Complete/Failed/Cancelled, Blocked->Pending/Cancelled, Verifying->InProgress/WorkProduced/Complete/Failed/Cancelled. Complete, Failed, and Cancelled are terminal.

mcp.name: unstick_dock
mcp.description: Unstick a wedged dock: release any captain still holding it back to Idle and reclaim its worktree so it stops pinning capacity. Committed branch history is preserved.

mcp.name: update_ask_thread
mcp.description: Rename, pin or unpin, archive or unarchive an Ask Armada conversation, change its captain (or clearCaptain to use the default), or change autoApprove. Only supplied fields change.

mcp.name: update_backlog_item
mcp.description: Update one backlog item, including prioritization, category, linked entities, and refinement metadata.

mcp.name: update_captain
mcp.description: Update a captain's name or runtime. Operational fields (state, process, mission) are preserved.

mcp.name: update_cli_permission_rule
mcp.description: Update a CLI permission rule's pattern, action, and description (admins of the rule's tenant).

mcp.name: update_failure_cause_rule
mcp.description: Update a failure-cause rule; omitted fields keep their stored values and match, when given, replaces the whole match. Rules for every tenant and built-in rules need a global admin. An edited built-in rule is never overwritten when the Admiral seeds the built-ins.

mcp.name: update_fleet
mcp.description: Update an existing fleet

mcp.name: update_fleet_action
mcp.description: Update a fleet action. Only the supplied fields change. Built-in actions can be edited.

mcp.name: update_harbor
mcp.description: [Experimental] Update a Harbor's operator-editable fields (name, capacity, enabled).

mcp.name: update_memory
mcp.description: Update an existing memory by id. Only supplied fields change. Use this to reconcile or augment an existing memory rather than creating a duplicate.

mcp.name: update_mission
mcp.description: Update an existing mission's title, description, priority, vessel, voyage, branch, or PR URL. Operational fields (status, timestamps, captain) are managed by the system.

mcp.name: update_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Update a managed model endpoint. Only supplied fields change; omit apiKey to keep the stored key.

mcp.name: update_objective
mcp.description: Update one objective/backlog entry, including prioritization, category, linked entities, and refinement metadata.

mcp.name: update_persona
mcp.description: Update an existing persona's properties

mcp.name: update_pipeline
mcp.description: Update an existing pipeline's properties and stages

mcp.name: update_playbook
mcp.description: Update an existing playbook.

mcp.name: update_prompt_template
mcp.description: Update a prompt template's content and description. Creates the template if it does not exist.

mcp.name: update_vessel
mcp.description: Update an existing vessel's properties

mcp.name: update_vessel_context
mcp.description: Update a vessel's project context and style guide without modifying other properties

mcp.name: update_workflow_profile
mcp.description: Update a workflow profile. Only the fields you pass change; omitted fields keep their stored values. Pass an empty string to clear a command, fleetId, or vesselId. Lists (languageHints, requiredInputs, expectedArtifacts, environments) replace the stored list when passed. The updated profile is validated before it is saved. Tenant admins only, as over REST.

mcp.name: validate_model_endpoint
mcp.description: Validate a model endpoint by issuing a real request (an embedding for embedding endpoints, a short completion for inference endpoints) and update its health status.

mcp.name: validate_workflow_profile
mcp.description: Validate a workflow-profile definition without saving it. Returns isValid, errors, warnings, the available check types, and the resolved command previews. Tenant admins only, as over REST.

mcp.name: verify_deployment
mcp.description: Run post-deploy verification for an existing deployment.

mcp.name: vessel_health
mcp.description: Get one vessel's health: the row with effective (override-aware) statuses, raw findings (criterion, status, detailCode, valueA, valueB), manual overrides, and dependencyCount. Dependency rows are not embedded; page them with list_vessel_dependencies.

mcp.name: voyage_status
mcp.description: Get status of a specific voyage: the voyage with its mission counts (TotalMissions, MissionCountsByStatus) and LastBlackBoxEntryId (its current black box entry, read it with get_blackbox). Missions are never embedded; read them one page at a time with enumerate (entityType missions, voyageId).
